_: tests/test_parity.py: the torch solver against the verbatim v1 NumPy solver (tests/reference_v1.py) on a 90x100 cell, 5 m domain with a burned channel, micro-relief, per-cell Horton fields, a finite soil store and 0.02 m of initial channel water; 30 intervals of 40 mm/hr then 10 dry, dt_s = 20 s, cfl_alpha = 0.15, gauge at (45, 50). v1 keeps h in float32 whatever the input dtype, which sets the float64 floor.
